messages:
alice_support: FYI customers reporting hourly usage in Console delayed by ~4-6 hours starting ~12:15 UTC. Tenants affected: acme-inc, beta-studio, nimblepay. Dashboard shows last visible hour stuck at 08:00 UTC while events are arriving.
ben_platform: Seeing a spike in consumer lag on topic `usage-events-prod` around 12:10. Group `usage-ingest-group` lag ~210k. K8s node restarted at 12:12 in us-west-2 cluster, might be related. :thinking:
carla_eng: Any auth or schema changes rolled out around then? We had an IDP cert rotation scheduled at 12:00 but it was targeted to control plane only.
maria_data: I dug into the ETL logs for acme-inc. The extractor was producing messages fine but the enrichment/downstream upsert service logged repeated 401s starting 12:11 until 12:20.
ben_platform: Interesting — our deploy-bot shows a token rotation job ran at 12:05 (deploy-bot: token-rotator job completed). Could be timing mismatch where consumers tried using old creds.
deploy-bot: token-rotator: rotated service token for `enricher-service` at 2024-06-20T12:05:03Z
tim_sre: Quick debug commands I ran:
```
# kafka consumer lag
kafka-consumer-groups.sh --bootstrap-server pk1:9092 --describe --group usage-ingest-group
# check offsets
SELECT max(offset) FROM usage_events WHERE tenant_id='acme-inc' AND ts >= '2024-06-20T12:00:00Z';
```
logs showed repeated `401 Unauthorized` from enricher: `auth: token expired`.
alice_support: Customer reported they saw "no recent hours" in the console and opened a support ticket. They included a trace id: trace-7f4d. They expect a postmortem if this recurs.
carla_eng: Root cause hypothesis: token-rotator rotated a credential but some ingest pods had long-lived connections that didn't pick up new token and were subsequently rejected by enricher, causing backpressure and consumer lag. That would stall the materialization pipeline and delay hourly rollups.
maria_data: Repro steps I used (local staging):
1) Start long-lived consumer with token A
2) Rotate token to B (simulate deploy-bot)
3) Enricher accepts only token B -> consumer gets 401s -> consumer pauses retry/backoff -> lag grows
Observed dashboard delay ~3-5 hours depending on retry backoff settings.
ben_platform: Mitigation — restart ingest pods to pick up new creds. I'm rolling a small restart in us-west-2 now. Will monitor lag. :white_check_mark:
tim_sre: Also adding a short-term policy: token rotation should publish a rolling restart hook for pods using the credential or use in-process token refresh. Filed ENGINF-2217.
alice_support: Communicated to affected customers with ETA ~45m for visibility to catch up. Ticket IDs attached.
carla_eng: Action items: (1) immediate: graceful restart of ingest pods in affected zones (ben) (2) mid-term: implement token refresh or watcher to avoid 401 spiral (carla) (3) alert: add monitor for sustained consumer lag >5m that ties to token rotation events (tim).
maria_data: Creating backfill job to replay missing hours for acme-inc and beta-studio after we confirm consumer catch-up. Will coordinate with support before backfill.
ben_platform: Restart done in us-west-2. Lag dropping from 210k -> 8k in 12 minutes. Consumer offsets catching up. Pushing patch to deployment to default shorter retry window on 401s.
alice_support: Thanks team. I'll keep customers updated and close tickets after we confirm historical rows appear in the Console. Please put notes in the incident doc.
carla_eng: I'll own the postmortem and include timeline + suggested fixes. Will ping once draft is ready. :memo:
maria_data: Backfill queued, will run once we see steady-state for offsets. ETA for backfill end-to-end ~2 hours.
ben_platform: Follow-up: we should add a checklist to token-rotation runbook to include a `kubectl rollout restart` for services that can't hot-refresh tokens. Filing follow-up: ENGINF-2218.
alice_support: Closing loop with customers now. Thanks everyone!
